source.author: verg
source.text: Obstipui, steteruntque comae et vox faucibus haesit.
source.text_original: Obstipui, steteruntque comae et vox faucibus haesit.
source.text_english: I was struck dumb; my hair stood on end and my voice stuck in my throat.
